title: Saree Traditional Portrait Edit
prompt_text: Transform [the person in the photo] into a traditional saree portrait. Outfit: elegant silk saree in [color choice: red / royal blue / emerald green] with intricate gold embroidery, matching jewelry (jhumkas, mangtikka, bangles). Background: traditional Indian palace courtyard or temple with soft ambient lamp light. Pose: graceful side angle, hands holding saree pallu. Style: cinematic Bollywood portrait aesthetic, golden hour soft light, film grain. Preserve facial features exactly.
